name: stamp-new-tool
title: New Tool
description: Creates a tool folder named name directly inside the supplied destination path.

settings.name: path
settings.title: Destination folder
settings.description: Existing parent folder. Creates path/name without adding tools or domain folders.

settings.name: type
settings.title: Type
settings.description: Optional domain metadata; does not add a folder.

settings.name: name
settings.title: Name
settings.description: Name of the new tool folder and executor; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

settings.name: address
settings.title: House Address
settings.description: Optional PATHS key when the destination is inside the House tools folder. Defaults to name.

settings.name: inherit_executor
settings.title: Inherit Executor
settings.description: When true, create only the semantic leaf settings and require a nearest-parent executor instead of creating a leaf executor.

settings.name: settings
settings.title: Run Settings
settings.description: Inputs for running the generated Tool.
